newsitem.title: USA: Ernst & Young revenues up more than 20 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Ernst & Young revenues up more than 20 pct in 1996.

text.p: Consulting firm Ernst & Young LLP said Monday its U.S. revenues jumped more than 20 percent in its recently completed 1996 fiscal year, exceeding the 1995 gain of 17 percent.
The company said its domestic revenues totalled $3.57 billion in its fiscal year ended Sept. 30, up from $2.97 billion a year earlier, which was double its 1994 revenues.
Ernst & Young, a partnership, does not report earnings.
The firm said 1996 was the second consecutive year it led the "Big Six" professional services firms in U.S. revenue growth.

Worldwide, Ernst & Young International posted double-digit growth for the second year in a row, it said. Revenues rose to $7.8 billion, a 13 percent increase over the $6.9 billion of the previous fiscal year.
